name: app-shell-01
title: App Shell 01
description: The application shell reference — AppShell's landmarks and skip link, a rail with search, inbox count, grouped links and a user menu, and a page of linked stat tiles.

Every item * has an icon. * * The items are inline sample data — replace `data` and swap each `` for your router's link. * * @example * * *

meta.whenToUse: Starting an application whose every route sits inside one shell and sidebar — copy it once, then hoist AppShell into a layout.
meta.whenNotToUse: You only need the shell mechanics in many places — install the app-shell component and compose it yourself.
